reason: The text explicitly states that Yahweh saved Israel from the Philistines (וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל). Throughout the passage, Yahweh is portrayed as actively intervening to deliver the Hebrew people from their enemies through Jonathan's victory. Jonathan expresses confidence that Yahweh will work with them to save Israel, demonstrating Yahweh's benevolent intent. The successful military outcome and Yahweh's direct intervention to rescue Israel from Philistine forces demonstrate concrete actions aligned with wanting the Hebrew people's well-being.
